hero.subtitle: Long PDFs and slides are hard to get through, and generic AI tools miss Albanian materials and ignore your level. MIK reads your material, explains it the way you need, and checks what you've actually learned.
hero.photoAlt: A student taking notes from their study material next to a laptop

one.title: A 50-page PDF and no time to read it
one.text: Deadlines pile up faster than pages get read. You need the core ideas first, then the detail.

two.title: Everyday AI tools don't get Albanian material
two.text: Answers drift off topic, terms get mistranslated, and nothing is tied back to your actual pages.

three.title: No real way to tell what you have learned
three.text: Rereading feels productive, but it doesn't show which topics you would still get wrong on exam day.

features.title: Everything you need to study one document, end to end

summary.title: Smart summaries
summary.text: Get the key ideas, concepts and takeaways from a lecture or a codebase in minutes.

level.title: Explanations at your level
level.text: Beginner, intermediate or advanced: the same material, explained the way you need it.

quiz.title: Automatic quizzes with feedback
quiz.text: Multiple-choice and short-answer questions, with feedback that shows what to revisit.

chat.title: Chat with your material
chat.text: Ask follow-up questions and get answers with citations to the exact page or slide.

teacher.title: A virtual teacher that speaks
teacher.text: Avatar Mode walks you through a long document out loud, section by section.

how.title: From upload to understanding in three steps

one.title: Upload your material
one.text: Drop in a PDF, a PPTX or a source code file, in Albanian or English.

two.title: Tailor it to you
two.text: Pick your level and language; every summary and explanation follows them.

three.title: Study and test yourself
three.text: Read, ask, listen and take quizzes. Weak topics get spotted and explained again.

teacher.title: Your virtual teacher
teacher.subtitle: An avatar that reads your materials aloud in a natural voice, pauses when you ask questions, and adapts the explanation to your level.

welcome.title: Welcome to MIK
welcome.intro: Upload your lectures, slides or source code and MIK turns them into clear summaries, explanations at your level, a chat that answers from your own material, and quizzes to check what you know. It works in Albanian and English.
welcome.nameHelper: So MIK can greet you by name and keep your profile yours.
welcome.roleOtherLabel: Tell us a bit about yourself
welcome.cityHelper: This helps us show the right university options for you.
welcome.universityHelper: Your university helps us tailor the level and materials.
welcome.degreeHelper: This helps us match the depth of explanations to your program.
welcome.yearHelper: So we can pace quizzes and explanations to where you are.
welcome.fieldOfWorkTitle: What field do you work in?
welcome.fieldOfWorkHelper: This helps us use examples and terminology that feel familiar.

studyGuide.title: Study Mode
studyGuide.subtitle: Learn the most effective way with MIK
studyGuide.stepsTitle: How to study with MIK in 4 steps

upload.title: Upload your material
upload.body: Upload a lecture as PDF or PPTX, or paste your code. MIK summarizes it for the level you choose.

listen.title: Listen and read
listen.body: The avatar explains the material out loud, section by section — ideal while you're on the move.

ask.title: Ask questions
ask.body: Ask in the chat and get answers only from your material, with references to the exact page or line.

test.title: Test yourself
test.body: Quizzes are generated automatically and show which topics are still weak, so you can review them.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro
pomodoro.body: 25 minutes of study, then a 5-minute break.

level.title: The right level
level.body: pick the level that fits you, neither too easy nor too hard.

review.title: Review
review.body: return to the quizzes you missed after 24 hours.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: write down the key points in your own words after each section.

rest.title: Rest
rest.body: your brain consolidates what you learned while you sleep.
